artifact_observations.location: Side of the cardboard box, bottom right
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text printed on the box is illegible and distorted, resembling AI-generated gibberish rather than clear branding or nutritional information. Characters merge and lack consistent geometry.
The frosting has an overly smooth, plastic-like sheen with subtle melting inconsistencies where it meets the cake base. It lacks the micro-texture expected from real cream cheese or buttercream.

The nut pieces and fruit toppings appear slightly fused into the frosting rather than sitting distinctly on top. Some nut shapes are ambiguous and lack sharp edges, suggesting minor generation artifacts.
